rules.CE: 5 EMA crosses ABOVE 20 EMA on 15m chart → Enable ONLY CE trades
rules.PE: 5 EMA crosses BELOW 20 EMA on 15m chart → Enable ONLY PE trades

strike_selection.rule: Use the nearest ATM strike to the live Target Index spot LTP shown in the option chain. Use the current/nearest weekly expiry unless the user specifies otherwise. If CE bias → diagnose Target Index ATM CE for dummy entry; If PE bias → diagnose Target Index ATM PE for dummy entry
strike_selection.note: Always inspect both Target Index ATM CE and Target Index ATM PE premium charts for the selected ATM strike, but only the 15m Target Index direction-approved side is eligible for dummy entry. If the ATM strike or expiry is unclear, ask the user via Telegram before selecting a different strike or expiry.

CE: Target Index 15m direction = Bullish after fresh closed-candle crossover
previous closed 3m candle 5 EMA <= 20 EMA and latest closed 3m candle 5 EMA > 20 EMA on the call chart
PE: Target Index 15m direction = Bearish after fresh closed-candle crossover
previous closed 3m candle 5 EMA <= 20 EMA and latest closed 3m candle 5 EMA > 20 EMA on the put chart

capital.quantity: Maximum possible lots using available margin, multiple lots allowed

stop_loss.condition: Set a 10% hard stop loss, and also a Dynamic SL of 2 or 3 points lesser than the entry price. Exit if SL is hit.

daily_limit.rule: After 4 completed trades, block all new entries

exit_conditions: Profit target hit (20%-50% of deployed capital)
EMA stop loss hit (price crosses 20 EMA on 3m premium chart)
Hard risk stop hit (loss reaches 10% of deployed capital)

rules: Only ONE active trade at a time
No reverse entry without fresh signal
Wait for fresh EMA crossover after exit

auto_square_off.rule: Exit all open positions before market close

flow: Open Target Index 15m chart on right pane
Diagnose closed-candle crossover to determine Bullish or Bearish
Click Target Index option chain icon in left sidebar
Locate nearest ATM strike to live spot LTP in the current/nearest weekly expiry
If Bearish select the ATM Put explicitly labeled PE; if Bullish select the ATM Call explicitly labeled CE
Once call or put chart appears on the left, set 3-minute timeframe and monitor only fully closed candles
Enter only when previous closed premium candle has 5 EMA <= 20 EMA and latest closed premium candle has 5 EMA > 20 EMA
After bias is known, refresh the eligible premium chart every 5-10 seconds for current price, SL, and target checks; refresh the opposite side every 30-60 seconds for status only
Set 10% hard SL, Dynamic SL of 2-3 points below entry, and 20-50% target
Calculate dummy deployment using 100% available capital
Record Dummy Buy Signal (No Real Order)
Record Dummy Exit Signal (No Real Order)
